blurb: BIGHORN is a private golf club community offering two championship golf courses, a variety of practice facilities, and a full social calendar. Members enjoy access to seven dining venues, tennis and pickleball courts, bocce ball, pools, a spa and wellness center, fitness classes, and luxurious locker rooms. The Clubhouse features modern architecture, multiple dining options, and event spaces with panoramic views.
extraNote: Membership is non-equity, non-voting, non-refundable, and non-transferable license
